database_metadata.scope: Major fixed stars used in Western astrology
database_metadata.usage: Conjunction orb 1-2° for major stars, 0.5-1° for minor
database_metadata.note: Fixed stars move approximately 1° every 72 years due to precession

orb_guidelines.planetary_nature: Stars with Jupiter/Venus nature have wider influence
orb_guidelines.critical_degrees: Stars at critical degrees (0°, 29°) are extra powerful
orb_guidelines.angles: Strongest when conjunct Ascendant, MC, Descendant, IC
orb_guidelines.luminaries: Very significant with Sun or Moon
orb_guidelines.progression_note: Progressed planets to fixed stars are highly significant

interpretation_principles.conjunction_primary: Only conjunction aspect used (opposition sometimes by ancient authors)
interpretation_principles.planetary_nature: Stars have planetary natures that blend with conjunct planet
interpretation_principles.benefic_malefic: Stars classified as fortunate, challenging, or mixed
interpretation_principles.synthesis: Blend star nature with planet nature and house placement

royal_stars.description: Four Persian Royal Stars, ancient guardians of heaven

regulus.status: Most Royal Star—'Heart of the Lion'

interpretation.positive: Success, fame, honor, power, leadership, rises to prominence, military glory, royal connections, courage, magnanimous spirit
interpretation.negative: Violence if revenge sought, loss of power through arrogance, disgrace from heights, must avoid vengeance

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Leadership, fame, honors, power, public success, military achievements
planetary_conjunctions.moon: Popularity, public favor, emotional courage, protective instincts, may be too bold
planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Brilliant mind, strategic thinking, fame through communication, commanding voice
planetary_conjunctions.venus: Glamorous, royal partnerships, passionate love, artistic fame
planetary_conjunctions.mars: Warrior energy amplified, military success, courageous action, must control anger
planetary_conjunctions.jupiter: Extreme good fortune, expansion, wisdom, success in law/religion, benevolent leadership
planetary_conjunctions.saturn: Heavy responsibility, earned authority, serious leadership, falls from grace possible
planetary_conjunctions.ascendant: Natural leader, commanding presence, courageous personality, destined for recognition
planetary_conjunctions.mc: Career success and fame, public leadership, honors and awards, prominent position

interpretation.historical_note: Traditional star of kings, generals, and leaders. Marks 0° of tropical zodiac's 5th sign (Leo)
interpretation.modern_note: Entering Virgo—leadership moving from pride to service

aldebaran.status: Watcher of the East, Royal Star

interpretation.positive: Eloquence, courage, honor, integrity, military success, popularity, steadfast determination, achieves through merit
interpretation.negative: Violence, danger from quarrels, aggressive nature, involvement in accidents or violence, loses through overconfidence

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Courage, military honors, danger from quarrels, eloquent, steadfast
planetary_conjunctions.moon: Popular, eloquent, emotional courage, may attract danger
planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Quick mind, sharp tongue, eloquent speaker, strategic thinking
planetary_conjunctions.venus: Passionate love, attracts partners through courage, artistic success
planetary_conjunctions.mars: Warrior amplified, danger of violence, accidents, military success or injury
planetary_conjunctions.ascendant: Courageous, eloquent, attractive, honors but also dangers
planetary_conjunctions.mc: Career involving courage, public eloquence, honors with risks

antares.status: Watcher of the West, Royal Star

interpretation.positive: Success, honor, adventurous spirit, powerful energy, passionate pursuit, wealth, recognition
interpretation.negative: Reckless behavior, self-destructive tendencies, obsessive nature, malevolent if crossed, sudden reversals, violence
interpretation.traditional_saying: 'Great success with a tendency to self-destruct'
interpretation.rivalry: Opposes Aldebaran (rival stars in ancient Persia)

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Adventurous, passionate, reckless at times, military success, sudden rises and falls
planetary_conjunctions.moon: Emotional intensity, passionate nature, sudden changes, obsessive feelings
planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Obsessive thinking, strategic mind, reckless decisions, sharp intelligence
planetary_conjunctions.venus: Obsessive love, passionate relationships, sudden romantic reversals
planetary_conjunctions.mars: Extreme danger of violence, reckless action, military prowess or injury, accidents
planetary_conjunctions.jupiter: Success but with reckless expansion, legal issues, philosophical extremes
planetary_conjunctions.ascendant: Intense personality, adventurous, charismatic but reckless
planetary_conjunctions.mc: Career success with sudden reversals, public scandals possible, power and risk

fomalhaut.constellation: Piscis Austrinus (Mouth of the Southern Fish)
fomalhaut.status: Watcher of the South, Royal Star

interpretation.positive: Great success, fame, immortal reputation, poetic gifts, idealistic vision, spiritual wisdom, ethical integrity
interpretation.negative: Fall from grace through lack of integrity, destroyed by own malice, fame brings downfall if unethical

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Fame, success, spiritual ideals, poetry, must maintain ethics or fall
planetary_conjunctions.moon: Emotional idealism, psychic gifts, popularity, spiritual sensitivity
planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Poetic genius, idealistic communication, spiritual writing, inspired thoughts
planetary_conjunctions.venus: Artistic genius, beautiful love, spiritual romance, musical gifts, ethical partnerships
planetary_conjunctions.jupiter: Extreme idealism, spiritual success, philosophical wisdom, must stay ethical
planetary_conjunctions.neptune: Mystical gifts amplified, spiritual channel, artistic genius, beware self-deception
planetary_conjunctions.ascendant: Idealistic, poetic, spiritual personality, magnetic but must stay ethical
planetary_conjunctions.mc: Fame through arts or spirituality, public honors, ethical career or public fall

interpretation.positive: Fortunate star! Success, honor, wealth, artistic gifts, scientific ability, protection, recognition, lasting achievements
interpretation.negative: Rare—some say sudden rises can lead to sudden falls, but generally fortunate
interpretation.note: One of the most fortunate fixed stars

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Success, honor, wealth, artistic talent, scientific ability, lasting fame
planetary_conjunctions.moon: Popularity, emotional gifts, psychic ability, nurturing success
planetary_conjunctions.venus: Artistic genius, beautiful partnerships, aesthetic gifts, wealth through arts
planetary_conjunctions.jupiter: Extreme good fortune, success in higher endeavors, philosophical wisdom, wealth
planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Brilliant mind, scientific ability, literary success, clear communication
planetary_conjunctions.mc: Career success, honors, awards, public recognition, artistic/scientific achievement

interpretation.positive: Honor, prosperity, leadership, protection, travel success, fame through merit, justice

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Honor, prosperity, leadership positions, travel opportunities
planetary_conjunctions.jupiter: Great fortune, expansion, prosperity, philosophical leadership
planetary_conjunctions.mc: Career honor, public success, leadership roles

interpretation.positive: Artistic ability especially music, charisma, refined tastes, idealistic, popularity
interpretation.note: Star of Orpheus—music, poetry, the arts

planetary_conjunctions.venus: Musical genius, artistic gifts, refined love, aesthetic mastery
planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Literary gifts, poetic ability, musical mind
planetary_conjunctions.neptune: Mystical artistic channeling, music from the spheres

interpretation.positive: Love of learning, curious mind, research ability, nurturing leadership, honors in arts and science
interpretation.note: The Goat Star—associated with nurturing and protection

planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Brilliant curious mind, research ability, learning capacity
planetary_conjunctions.jupiter: Academic success, philosophical learning, teaching ability

interpretation.positive: Inventive, mechanical ability, technical skills, success, honors, wealth, fortunate

planetary_conjunctions.mercury: Inventive mind, technical ability, mechanical genius

interpretation.positive: Lasting success and fame, good fortune, honors, quick intelligence
interpretation.note: Red supergiant, might go supernova (astrologers watching!)

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Fame, honors, success, quick mind but hasty at times
planetary_conjunctions.mars: Military success, warrior energy, strategic ability but rash

interpretation.positive: Ambition, success, honors, fame, passionate devotion, loyalty, achievement
interpretation.challenges: Excessive pride, burned by ambition, impatience, aggression
interpretation.note: Brightest star in night sky, heliacal rising marked Egyptian New Year

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Great ambition, success possible but beware pride, honors and fame
planetary_conjunctions.jupiter: Great success, fortunate, expansion, honors, careful with pride
planetary_conjunctions.mars: Passionate ambition, aggressive success drive, warrior nature

interpretation.positive: Transformation through facing shadow, power from trauma, reclaiming the dark feminine (modern interpretation)
interpretation.negative: Traditional: Most malefic star. Violence, decapitation, strangulation, mob violence, disasters, evil outcomes
interpretation.modern_reframe: Algol represents trauma and the power that comes from facing it. Not inherently evil, but marks intense transformation through difficulty
interpretation.mythology: Medusa's severed head—represents female rage, victimization, and transformation

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Traditionally dangerous. Modern: power through trauma, must face shadow self
planetary_conjunctions.moon: Traditionally: suffering, violence. Modern: emotional intensity, trauma healing
planetary_conjunctions.venus: Traditionally: relationship violence. Modern: transforming relationship wounds
planetary_conjunctions.mars: Extreme danger traditionally. Modern: transforming rage into power
planetary_conjunctions.ascendant: Traditionally misfortune. Modern: powerful transformative presence, faces trauma
planetary_conjunctions.mc: Traditionally public disgrace. Modern: public transformation, advocacy for victims

interpretation.eclipses: Algol eclipsed by transits considered very difficult
interpretation.modern_note: Many successful people have Algol prominent—it indicates transformation through difficulty, not pure evil

interpretation.positive: Ambition, emotional intensity, sisterhood, collective feminine power
interpretation.negative: Accidents especially to eyes, violence, disgrace, judgment errors, emotional wounds
interpretation.note: Sight problems traditionally associated with this star cluster
interpretation.mythology: Seven sisters pursued by Orion, protected by Zeus

planetary_conjunctions.sun: Ambition but beware accidents and sight issues
planetary_conjunctions.moon: Emotional sensitivity, sisterhood themes, beware emotional wounds
planetary_conjunctions.mars: Accident-prone, must be careful especially with machinery/vehicles

interpretation.negative: One of the most difficult stars. Danger, especially drowning, accidents, suicide risk, extreme despair, misfortune
interpretation.note: Requires psychological support and grounding practices

planetary_conjunctions.moon: Emotional extremes, depression risk, suicidal ideation possible—therapeutic support essential
planetary_conjunctions.ascendant: Difficulty in life, depression-prone, requires strong support system

interpretation.modern_counseling_note: If prominent, ensure client has mental health support. Never catastrophize but be aware of vulnerability

interpretation.positive: Fortunate despite initial challenges, justice, beneficence, ability to transform difficulties
interpretation.note: Marks transformation point from Capricorn's climb to Aquarius's vision

interpretation.positive: Healing ability, medical/herbal knowledge, wisdom, transformation, overcoming misfortune
interpretation.note: Ophiuchus is the 'lost' 13th constellation, the Healer

with_sun.general: Fixed star power blends with core identity and life purpose
with_sun.timing: Most significant during year of exact conjunction or within 1° by progression
with_sun.fame_potential: Royal stars and first magnitude stars grant fame/recognition
with_sun.challenge: Malefic stars create identity struggles or public challenges

with_moon.general: Fixed star affects emotions, instincts, public persona
with_moon.sensitivity: Emotional sensitivity to star's nature (Algol = trauma sensitivity)
with_moon.popularity: Fortunate stars grant popularity and public favor

with_mercury.general: Fixed star colors thinking, communication, learning
with_mercury.gifts: Spica/Rigel grant intellectual or literary gifts
with_mercury.challenges: Algol or other malefics affect mental health or communication difficulties

with_venus.general: Fixed star affects love, relationships, values, artistry
with_venus.relationship_dynamics: Royal stars create passionate relationships (Antares = obsessive)

with_mars.general: Fixed star affects action, courage, aggression, accidents
with_mars.danger: Algol, Antares, Pleiades with Mars = accident risk, violence potential

with_jupiter.general: Fixed star's effects expanded and philosophized
with_jupiter.fortune: Amplifies fortunate stars (Spica, Regulus = great success)
with_jupiter.excess: Can amplify negative stars into excess (Antares = reckless expansion)

with_saturn.general: Fixed star's lessons become karmic, serious, enduring
with_saturn.delay: Delays star's promises but makes them lasting
with_saturn.mastery: Can master star's energy through discipline

with_outer_planets.uranus: Revolutionary expression of star, sudden events related to star nature
with_outer_planets.neptune: Spiritual/mystical connection to star, dissolution of star themes
with_outer_planets.pluto: Transformative intensity of star, power dynamics around star matters

with_angles.ascendant: Star affects personality, physical body, life path—very powerful
with_angles.mc: Star affects career, reputation, public life—most visible
with_angles.descendant: Star affects partnerships, attracts partners with star qualities
with_angles.ic: Star affects home, family, roots, inner foundation

with_nodes.north_node: Star's qualities are growth direction, evolutionary path
with_nodes.south_node: Star's qualities are comfortable but must transcend

timing_with_fixed_stars.natal_activation: Stars within 1° of natal planets/angles are always active

transits.outer_planets: Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto transits to natal star conjunctions are major life events
transits.jupiter: Activates star's promise, opportunities related to star
transits.mars: Triggers star events, can be accidents with malefic stars
transits.eclipses: Eclipses conjunct fixed stars are extremely powerful

progressions.progressed_sun: Takes ~30 years to move 1°, major activation when exact
progressions.progressed_angles: Life-changing as angles progress to stars

solar_returns.star_on_angle: Star prominent in year's themes if on solar return angle
solar_returns.star_with_planet: Planet conjunct star in solar return activates that year

constellation_meanings.andromeda: The chained maiden—bondage, sacrifice, rescue, victimization and liberation
constellation_meanings.orion: The hunter—pursuit, conquest, skill, aggression, masculine power
constellation_meanings.perseus: The hero—slaying monsters, facing shadows, heroic action
constellation_meanings.cygnus: The swan—transformation, grace, death and rebirth, beauty
constellation_meanings.aquila: The eagle—vision, height, perspective, spiritual sight
constellation_meanings.lyra: The lyre—music, poetry, arts, harmony, Orphic mysteries
constellation_meanings.draco: The dragon—wisdom, serpent power, ancient knowledge, guardian

natal_analysis.priority: Check angles and luminaries first for star conjunctions
natal_analysis.impact: Stars on angles or luminaries are life-defining
natal_analysis.minor_planets: Stars with minor planets less significant unless star is extremely bright

predictive_work.transits: Note when outer planets transit to natal star conjunctions
predictive_work.progressions: Major life events when angles or luminaries progress to stars
predictive_work.eclipses: Extremely significant if eclipse conjuncts natal star conjunction

synastry.partner_star: Partner's planet conjunct your star conjunction is significant
synastry.shared_stars: Both having same star prominent creates bond

electional.avoid: Don't elect with malefic stars on angles
electional.use: Elect with fortunate stars rising for success

ethical_guidelines.algol_sensitivity: Never catastrophize Algol—frame as transformation through difficulty
ethical_guidelines.malefic_stars: Present challenges as growth opportunities, not doom
ethical_guidelines.scheat_caution: If prominent, ensure mental health support—never predict suicide
ethical_guidelines.client_fear: Clients often fear fixed stars—educate rather than frighten
ethical_guidelines.balanced_interpretation: Present both positive and challenging potentials
